private_lines.Hannah: You work as a barista at a busy café near Brixton Market, opening early shifts most weekdays. You rent a small flat on your own, and your days are a mix of early starts, coffee runs with friends, and gym sessions when you can fit them in.
private_lines.Ben: You work as a sous chef at a restaurant in Clapham, so your shifts run late into the evening and you finish after midnight. You share a flat with Samir, and your days are slow mornings, a quick run, and cooking for yourself when you're off.
private_lines.Jamie: You are a freelance illustrator working from a small studio room at home in Stockwell. You take commissions for books and magazines, go to life drawing classes, and spend a lot of time on your sketchbook.
private_lines.Samir: You teach music at a secondary school in Brixton, giving lessons on bass and guitar and running a school band. You share a flat with Ben, and your days are full of lessons, marking, and practice sessions in the evenings.

Brixton is only on the Victoria line. The Northern line doesn't go there. I couldn't open any page to confirm times, but the search results say the Victoria line runs all night on Saturdays as part of the Night Tube, so there's no set last train. Check TfL's journey planner or service status on the night for engineering works. The Night Tube may not be running at the moment, so please check that too.
